quest.title: Test of Courage
quest.description: You heard that the Test of Courage is being held. Maybe you should head to the Yashiro Commission to have a look...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the Yashiro Commission to ask about the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayato~!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Long time no see!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. Yes, it has been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we heard the Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage, so we came right over to sign ourselves up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't expect to see you here in person, though. Does that mean this event is really important?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: You think I only make an appearance for occasions that are deemed sufficiently important? Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: It just so happens that this Test of Courage event was actually my suggestion, but naturally, I've left the planning and more trifling details to be arranged by my retainers.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Considering that such events are quite popular across Teyvat, I've had numerous examples to draw from, so everything should be in good order. I'm merely here to do a routine check on the progress of the event, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it... so what you're saying is you're not very busy right now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, maybe you can give us a quick rundown of the event rules!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Heh, only Paimon could be so natural at ordering others around.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: However... the possibility remains that we may yet require your assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, sorry? What did you say?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Ah, nothing. Hehe, seeing as I apparently have some time, I suppose we may chat about the event for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yippee!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, Ayato.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: As its name implies, the event is a game designed to put one's courage to the test.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: The venue for the event will be set up in the Chinju Forest. Before the start of each round, participants will be divided into teams of two.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Once teams have been formed, the event staff will announce the name of an item that has been placed in or around the Chinju Forest area.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: The first person to locate the specified item will be declared the winner of that round.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "The winner of that round"? Huh, so there's gonna be multiple rounds to the Test of Courage?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Precisely. There will be a total of three rounds in the Test of Courage because the event was actually orchestrated by three different parties.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Merchants raised event funding, the Kamisato Clan provided the grounds, and the Grand Narukami Shrine provided consulting services.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: As such, each of these three parties have selected one item for participants to find, so naturally, the event will require three rounds to determine the winners.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Paimon gets it. So basically, it boils down to searching for stuff in Chinju Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll need to find one item each round, for a total of three items after three rounds. Simple enough for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Yes, seems you've got the gist of it. We will be issuing different rewards based on the number of rounds won, so if a participant wins multiple rounds, then that will also be reflected in their final reward.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: If a participant manages to find all three items, then they shall receive the grand prize provided by the Grand Narukami Shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, a grand prize! Sounds like it could be really valuable!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: As for its true value, I'm afraid you'll have to win the event first and ask Lady Guuji yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Of course, this event is intended to measure your courage. If you withdraw from the event because you become too frightened, then you might as well forget about seeing any rewards.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: I'm curious myself how many people will be brave enough to make it to the end. It'll be most disappointing if nobody claims the prizes we've prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, those prizes are as good as ours!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Even though just the thought of this event sends shivers down Paimon's little spine, {NICKNAME} will be brave enough, no doubt about that!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: I appreciate your enthusiasm. Hehe, I look forward to seeing how you perform.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Anyway, I think I've given you sufficient details. I'll add your names to the list of participants momentarily.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: As for the three items you'll be searching for, please wait for a staff member to inform you at the start of the event.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Oh, and a friendly word of advice... Test of Courage events tend to give rise to a variety of strange rumors and stories, so please, be sure to exercise caution.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! What did he mean by that!? Oh, will there be spooky things in Chinju Forest?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh! Now even you're trying to scare Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we've got an event to win... Grand prize, here we come!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, Paimon thought so, too... Well, in that case, there's nothing to be scared of!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: No need to be so modest. Your journey thus far already speaks volumes of your bravery.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, this looks like the place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or does it look a lot scarier than usual here?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! Don't sneak up on Paimon like that! What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah nothing, I just had a thought occur to me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I want to scare the gang members real good, but now that I think about it, I've never actually scared anyone before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You're only now realizing this?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you mean you want to practice first?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Practice? Oh, now there's an idea.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, I've got it! Why don't you join the Test of Courage like everyone else, and I'll go hide and try to scare you from time to time?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Then, you two can judge my scaring skills. Alright, that's the plan. Lemme go get ready!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Just wait, you'll see how scary this oni can be! Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And there he goes, running off and still talking to himself...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we were here to join the event anyway. Guess we'll just have to pass Itto's little "test" along with whatever else the event throws at us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, seems one of the event staff is over there. Let's go talk to her.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hold it right there! Haha, well if it isn't my compadres! Didn't expect to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon knows that voice... It's Itto! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, don't tell Paimon that you're here for the Test of Courage.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hah, what else! I'm sorry, but those prizes already belong to yours truly... Arataki "Ain't Scared of Nothin'" Itto!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I mean, well, that's what I really wanna say... But uh, I've actually got something else goin' on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah, it's a long story. As soon as I heard about the Test of Courage, I got the gang together and was ready to bring everyone for the time of their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But uh, it turns out the other members weren't as pumped about the event as me...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: "Chinju Forest? We've already been there a million times. There's nothing scary about that place!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: "That event's just a game for kids! What a waste of time... Let's play some Genius Invokation TCG!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: "Seriously, Test of Courage!? Ugh, whatever. I guess if that's what the boss wants..."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Can you believe that!? What a group of deadbeats... I'm not gonna put up with that, nuh-uh, not in my gang!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon gets it now... dragging the gang to an event they don't want to go to won't be the best for your reputation as a leader.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, this isn't about me!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: As leader of the Arataki Gang, it's my duty to find new and tantalizing experiences for everyone. A happy gang means a happy life!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Even if they can't get it through their stubborn heads now, one way or another, I'll show them how much fun a Test of Courage can be!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anywayyy, I'm no stranger to Chinju Forest. Sure, it was a little terrifying going through there, but hey, I'm used to it now!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: And seriously, what kind of scary pranks could those guys in the Yashiro Commission ever come up with? If they can't scare anyone, then it's not gonna be a "test of courage" now, is it?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Not to mention, if the gang starts complaining... I won't ever be able to show my face around here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And after all that talk, it still boils down to you!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, well, leading a gang can be complicated. You don't understand... Anywho, I've got a plan.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Since there's no way I can trust the Yashiro Commission to make a fun event, I've decided to step in and spice things up a little.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you don't seriously mean that...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh, you bet I do! Yours truly is gonna be out scaring people! Hahaha, I'm taking this event to a whole 'nother level!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But it's gonna take more than an oni to make it happen... So I came here to recruit some help, and then I saw you come walking along.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: C'mon! Come scare people with me, please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Pretty please!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Forget it!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Pretty pretty pleaseee!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, fine! But don't forget, we're here to win the Test of Courage and take home the grand prize.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll help you out. Just don't get in the way of our prize.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha, yes! You're a real oni saver! Don't worry, with me around, winning the Test of Courage will be a piece of cake.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Alright, those participants won't scare themselves! Let's get out there, hahaha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a noisy guy... Hmm, but after hearing him laugh and talk, Paimon doesn't feel scared anymore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, maybe laughter is the key to making fear go away! If things get scary later, we can all start laughing at the top of our lungs!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #Hey! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, enough chitchat! We're gonna miss the event!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Coming!

choices.text: Pretty sure that would just make things even scarier...
You sure do care about your gang members...

talks.objective: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, it's Ayaka! Are you here for the Test of Courage, too?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, my brother told me that the event would be "most interesting," and suggested that I personally participate.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I have never experienced a Test of Courage event, so I don't really know what to expect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so this is your first time?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: To be frank, I'm no expert when it comes to the supernatural... I often worry that I haven't shown spirits proper respect and have brought shame upon my clan.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of which, may I ask if the two of you are partners for the event?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, the shrine maiden just told us that we only count as a single participant, however that works... so we're looking for a partner now!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Splendid. In that case, how would you like to be my partner?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I always feel at ease when you're by my side. Ah, but of course, please don't let me get in the way if you wish to participate with someone else...

choices.text: I want to partner up with Ayaka.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh, you'd really like to? Then it's my honor... Or I suppose I should say, please pardon my inexperience.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: And if I appear to be frightened, please promise not to laugh at me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Sure, I understand. I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You may let me know if you need anything.

talks.objective: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Aha, you must be here to participate in the Test of Courage?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep, that's right! Uh, judging from your outfit, you must be one of the shrine maidens from the Grand Narukami Shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: That's right. Huh, I can already see a dark aura surrounding the two of you... Yes, truly ominous.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: If you carelessly go running into the event, all it'll take is one little misstep and the darkness will swallow you up, hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! What's with the sinister laugh...? Is she really a shrine maiden?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Sure you don't want to back out? This is your last chance. I'll count it down... three... two... one. Welcome to the Test of Courage... Enter at your own risk.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, was that the first test?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Sure, you could say that. You know, the most unfortunate tales always happen unexpectedly on just a normal, average day... just like today.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: But no need to worry. Allay your qualms and suspicions... Everything was already set into motion the moment you two stepped into this place.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Just enjoy the calm before the storm... The first round is about to begin. Have you already decided on your partner?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, you finally said something that Paimon can understand! Yep, the two of us will be partners! We always make the best team!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: ...Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: #But it appears your names were written together as a single participant... "{NICKNAME} and Paimon."

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Which means, you'll have to find yourselves another partner in order to join the event.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, are you serious!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, if only Itto hadn't gone running off on his own, we could have had a partner! Now what should we do?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: As far as I know, there have been other participants who have yet to designate a partner. You could go ask around.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Just be sure to make it quick. If you don't have a partner by the time the event starts, then you'll be immediately disqualified!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, we can't let that happen! Let's go see if we can find anyone to partner up with nearby!

talks.objective: Pick a partner out of the three contestants

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: So, have you given it some thought?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Ayaka.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Oh, you'd really like to? Then it's my honor... Or I suppose I should say, please pardon my inexperience.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: And if I appear to be frightened, please promise not to laugh at me.

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ah, I see. That's alright.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You may let me know if you need anything.

talks.objective: Begin the first round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Ah, it looks like you've found yourselves a partner.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: The event is just about to start. I will now reveal the item you'll be looking for in the first round.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: It's called "Dango Milk."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dango Milk?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Correct. Tomoki was kind enough to provide us with his Dango Milk and it has been hidden somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: The path will be marked with <color=#00E1FFFF>signs</color> to guide you, but some strange and unusual things may occur along the way... If you ever feel you can't handle it, you may withdraw from the event at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Now, if you're ready, then you may begin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We don't want anyone to beat us to it — let's go!

talks.objective: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Look, everyone. Isn't this the Dango Milk we are searching for?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And there's a scarecrow beside it. Strange... What is that doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't matter now! Since we found the Dango Milk, then we must be the first ones here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there's no way we can carry back so much Dango Milk. Why don't we drink some to lighten the load a little?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon could use a sip... Whaa!!! The scarecrow stood up!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It appears to be guarding the Dango Milk here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean, it's watching if we touch the Dango Milk? Uh, don't worry, P—Paimon didn't even touch it!

choices.text: Let's try not to scare ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, maybe you're right, Paimon will try to calm down... Let's try some together!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You drink some Dango Milk with Ayaka...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm, tastes great!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Indeed. Any fears I had a moment ago seem to have been dissipated by the Dango Milk.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: And now that I look around, this is Chinju Forest as I have always known it. After making it here, it doesn't seem nearly as frightening.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: My brother once said that fear stems from one's heart, and if your heart is at peace, then fear naturally dissipates. Now I understand what he meant.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: But fear is not entirely bad... Although I've been scared a few times, I still feel happy now.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I would like to continue walking through the forest for a while. Will you accompany me?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I saw someone I know just now...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Ah, I see. Well, I shall continue walking while you go greet your friend.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Don't worry. Now that I've experienced the event once already, I won't be easily frightened. I'll see you later. Have a lovely chat with your friend.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm, it seems we'll be the first to find it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I can sense a sweet aroma on the wind. The Dango Milk should be nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? Let Paimon have a look here... Oh, you're right! There it is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yippee! Who would've guessed we'd be the first ones! Hmm? But what's that scarecrow doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Careful...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaa!!! It... It's standing up! Is it alive!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Oh, well it sure worked on Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that should be the end of it... right? There doesn't seem to be anything else around here.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: It seems the test wasn't as scary as I had anticipated. However, I have enjoyed the experience together with you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Now that we've found the Dango Milk, we can head back the way we came.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: What's the matter? Is there something over there?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I saw someone I know just now...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Ah, I see. So she is at the Test of Courage, too.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: To avoid any unnecessary complications, I'd prefer not to meet with her. You may pass on my regards.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: There is a lot of Dango Milk here. I'll take half of it back and leave the rest to you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Till we meet again.

choices.text: It's just a device meant to scare you.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Have you found a partner yet?

talks.objective: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: *sniff* *sniff* That's the scent of Dango Milk — we've found it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It really is Dango Milk! A lot of it, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And look, there's a scarecrow here. Now who could have knocked it over— Wh—Whaa!!! It's standing up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ghost! It's a ghost! {NICKNAME}, save Paimon!

choices.text: It's only a trick meant to scare people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, really? Whew, that almost scared Paimon's socks right off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, looks like we managed to be the first ones here! Hehe, with so much Dango Milk, it wouldn't hurt if we drink a couple of bottles, right?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Is that permitted?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Everyone knows that Dango Milk spoils quickly if it's left out. Besides, we should try some!

response.speaker: <UNKNOWN_NPC_ID_FORMAT>
response.text: You drink some Dango Milk with Gorou...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Mmm, that's delicious! I would like to buy some to bring back to Watatsumi Island.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I bet the troops would be happy to have such a good-tasting drink. It's unfortunate that it spoils easily...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Let's split the remaining bottles and start heading back. Ready?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think I saw someone I know just now...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Oh, was it one of your friends? Do you need to go talk to them?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: In that case, I don't want to get in your way. I'll take back the remaining Dango Milk. Maybe I'll run into you in the next Test of Courage round!

choices.text: There's nothing to be scared of.

talks.objective: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ei?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's really you! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. Miko told me about the Test of Courage event taking place here. I thought I would come and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, so that's why you're here. So, what do you think of the Test of Courage, are you having fun?

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: It's more or less the same as I remember before.

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I wasn't scared by anything... But on the contrary, some of the event participants were horrified the moment they saw me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that Miko! Did she send Ei here to scare people on purpose!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If that's the case, it feels like Ei isn't really experiencing the event like everyone else...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon has an idea! We'll give you a bottle of the Dango Milk we just found. That would make you a winner in this round, too!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Ah yes, isn't that the dessert drink we had the last time we met? Sure, I'll take one.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Actually, I've sensed a familiar feeling ever since I arrived here. It's brought some old memories to mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? A familiar feeling?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Have you been down to the beach by any chance?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I was just strolling nearby when I noticed a space at the beach with a familiar game set up on it.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I took a brief look, and it appeared to be a game where you control flippers hovering in the air to strike a ball and hit some positioned elemental cubes.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I saw the game was called "Akitsu Yuugei." I'm guessing it originated from "Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura." The thought of that game caused me to recall some things from the past.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura? What's that?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It's a game where you use hagoita to hit a ball towards a set target. It was once quite popular during festivals.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Makoto also enjoyed playing Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura when she was alive. Hyakkiyakou was still around at that time, and nights in Inazuma were much more lively than they are now.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: The youkai would hold festivals from time to time, gathering to drink, laugh, and play music...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, does that mean you could eat the delicious festival food whenever you liked?

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Yes. The youkai called their celebration the "Mikawa Flower Festival." Makoto and I attended it once... She found it particularly fascinating.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Sadly, the past has all but vanished. But seeing a game like that again does make me feel happy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like it could be fun! Paimon would like to play!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: If you're interested, you can go to the beach and give it a try.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: It was still being set up when I was there earlier, but I assume it should be ready soon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay!

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I shall return to Tenshukaku. Miko told me that the Test of Courage consists of three rounds, so please keep up the effort and give it your best until the end.

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: Considering you two, I think you should have no problem making it to the end.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, of course! Hehe...

response.speaker: Ei
response.text: I know you can do it, good luck.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't remember hearing anything about a game on the beach from Ayato... You think that activity's also planned by the Yashiro Commission?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, the more Paimon thinks about it, the scarier it feels... Ugh, this whole Test of Courage thing is keeping Paimon on edge!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, the first round of the event should be finished by now, so let's head back!

choices.text: Sure sounds like something she'd do...

talks.objective: Return to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: So? What'd you think? Do I know how to scare people or what!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh uh, let Paimon think...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon was hiding behind you the entire time, so Paimon didn't really notice Itto scaring us at all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh, Paimon will leave this one to {NICKNAME}! So, was Itto scary or not?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What? No way! Listen, every time I made my move, I scared the living daylights out of everyone!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Even I had no idea I possessed such talent... But this is just what I needed to hear! Now I'll show 'em — the gang will know just how terrifying their leader can be!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Anyway, I already figured out which path they'll be taking, so let's wait nearby and scare the pants off 'em!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha, now things are getting interesting! You ready? We've got people to scare!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh? Really?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Do you need me to be your partner?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Kazuha.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well, then. I wouldn't mind a walk together.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I haven't participated in many of these events, so I'm curious what new experiences lie ahead.

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Sure, please don't worry about me.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The point of friends gathering is to have a good time. Worrying will only dampen the mood.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Shh... I think we're getting close.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: C'mon c'mon c'mon!!! Can't let them see us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, here they come... So how are you going to scare them, Itto?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Easy peasy. We'll wait for them to get real close, and then we'll jump out and shout together. They won't know what hit them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What're we, a bunch of kids now...?

choices.text: I kinda doubt this will work...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, don't underestimate me. It may sound simple, but I know exactly what will scare them.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: The gang's probably moping along on their way back, saying things like, "this is boring" and "let's go home."

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But it's dark and their guard is down — now's our chance. Having the three of us suddenly come flying outta the bushes is gonna scare 'em real good.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Before they come to their senses, we'll already be half-way to our next ambush spot!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Shh! You hear that? Someone's coming. It must be them.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Alright, I'll count us in, ready? We jump on zero! Three...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Two...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: One...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haaah!!!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wooga booga booga!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh!? Wait, you're not—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—They're... They're...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ghosts!
Ghosts!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait, hold on a second.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh! Did you see that!? They were definitely not human!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So all the strange rumors about the Test of Courage are true... Oh, what should we do? Do you think the ghosts are coming after us?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Haha, Paimon, I didn't expect you to be such a baby!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you're one to talk! You were the first to start running! Don't make fun of Paimon!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Well, you shouted "ghosts," so my instinct to escort you two to safety kicked in.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: After all, real "ghosts" are terrifying, my skills are completely useless against 'em!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, why did we stop running?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh, because I just realized that they were also running from us.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Which means they were afraid of us, too... And if that's the case, then there shouldn't be anything to worry about.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Now that I've calmed down, I'm starting to wonder if they were actually ghosts... They might have been people dressed up as ghosts to scare us!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Were they sent by the Yashiro Commission then?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Definitely not. During the event, I took a little walk around the Chinju Forest and saw all the gimmicks that the Yashiro Commission had set up.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Those three weren't from the Yashiro Commission, but they did seem a little familiar...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: C'mon, let's go back there and take a look!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Now you wanna go back?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: B—But... th—there's still a chance that they were real spirits, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we go back now, they might try to eat us...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: #It's alright, Paimon. If you're scared, you can stay here. {NICKNAME} and I will go investigate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Whew, that'd be great!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But wouldn't it be more dangerous to stay here alone?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! The last mystery novel Paimon bought from Yae Publishing House had a plot just like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: During the investigation, whoever said "I'm not going" would always be the next victim.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, so on second thought, Paimon's going with you. Don't ever leave Paimon behind! EVER!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It looked like they were running that way. But it's hard to say exactly where they went, so let's split up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But then you'll be all alone, which, according to the mystery novels, is super dangerous.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha! Don't worry about me. Once my rear's in gear, I'm not afraid of nothin'.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh~ Paimon has a bad feeling about this...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: They scared you that bad, huh? Looks like they really do have a knack for spooking people.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: This time, I'll capture them and learn their art for scaring people! Anyway, I'll catch you around!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there he goes, running off and talking to himself... again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, do we really have to go?

choices.text: We'd better go have a look.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh fine, let's go take a look then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the second we see anything scary, we make a run for it! Got it?

choices.text: Just sitting here won't accomplish anything.
So what exactly were you practicing all this time?

talks.objective: Follow the people that ran away
Follow the people that ran away

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we've already walked all the way here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, wonder where those three went... Paimon didn't see them anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe Itto was right! Maybe they've been hiding. Seems like they're not scary after all!

choices.text: Sounds like you've come to your senses.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Listen up, you three little wimps! Paimon can already see you guys, so just come out and show yourselves!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waaaah!!! There's someone actually here! Paimon's scared again!
Don't do it, Chizuru...
You can't give in to your desires... Others will suffer for it. You mustn't make the same mistake...
Just hold on a little longer... you've already come all this way, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, excuse us. Did you happen to see three rascals pass by here? Let Paimon tell you what they look like...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is it me, or does it look like she's burying something?
Are you... talking to me?
To... someone like me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Waaaah!!!
You have no business coming here. You shouldn't be anywhere near me...
If you value your lives, you must leave immediately. Otherwise, your souls will be trapped here forever.
I won't warn you again. Now, away with you... be gone...!
Wake up. Hey, Traveler... wake up!

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Thank goodness you're okay.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Before we get to that, I think someone needs your attention first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sobbing*... Please don't eat Paimon... Paimon doesn't taste very good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Please! Avenge Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah! Are you here to rescue Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, and Heizou's here too! Huh? What happened to that scary person just now? Did you manage to defeat her?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Scary person?

choices.text: There was a person wearing a weird outfit...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Okay, I see...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I only found the two of you passed out here when I arrived. There was no one else around.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: What happened? Tell me all the details.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Heizou everything that just happened...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: As I suspected, there appears to be something more behind this Test of Courage event.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: But let's get back to your original question, I haven't told you the reason I'm here.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: The truth is, I was commissioned to come here for an investigation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You were... commissioned?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: That's right. Some time ago, a peculiar game was discovered on the beach.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A peculiar game on the beach... Ohh, could it be the Akitsu Yuugei game that Ei mentioned?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Ah, so you've heard of it...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: The game quietly appeared some time ago and has since attracted some players. Apparently, it's very interesting.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: There was no one on the beach other than visitors and tourists when the game appeared. Imagine it like this: a stall suddenly appears on the street with no owner...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: And stranger yet, it could operate normally without anyone supervising it. People at the beach can start the game simply by talking to the Bulletin Board...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Could it be run by... ghosts?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Some tourists started to say that, and the rumor began to spread, until it became a full-blown ghost story. The further that story spread, the more plausible it seemed, causing people to be unwilling to go anywhere near the beach.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: The Tenryou Commission wanted to close the beach in order to investigate the situation and dispel the rumors, but before they could do anything, the Yashiro Commission organized the Test of Courage event here.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: People that were initially scared by the rumors began to believe that the "beach game" was actually a preview event planned by the Yashiro Commission for the Test of Courage, so visitors have gradually returned again.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: But I'm quite positive that the game never had anything to do with the Yashiro Commission...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so the Yashiro Commission were fully aware of all the spooky stuff going on, but they still decided to hold their event here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... Ayato must be one of the smartest guys we know. What the heck was he thinking!?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Who knows? But I'd rather trust tangible evidence than speculate on his thoughts.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: As for my commission, apparently someone reported that they found themselves trapped for hours on the beach while playing the game.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: According to his own account, he kept returning to the same location no matter which way he went, and even though his friends were nearby, they couldn't see him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, that sounds so scary!

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Even though it was obvious that he wasn't telling me the whole story, the testimonies of his friends did validate that what he said actually occurred.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: On top of that, it was also this very incident that led to all the ghost rumors. No one dared to go near the beach until the Yashiro Commission announced the Test of Courage...

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Who set up the game on the beach? And why did the Yashiro Commission help them cover it up?

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: I need to uncover the truth, so I'm here to investigate.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: Anyway, don't mind me. Working together will only raise suspicion, so I'll undertake my own investigation for the time being.

response.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
response.text: However, please proceed with caution. Based on my observations, most people are still unaware of anything happening here. Telling people that something's amiss might cause quite a stir.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The air is permeated with strange fragrance of flowers, which makes you drowsy...

choices.text: You're finally back to your normal self, Paimon.

talks.objective: Complete the first round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gorou!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Ah {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I didn't expect to run into you here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here for the Test of Courage! How about you?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Well... I was originally headed to Yae Publishing House to hand in responses for this month's issue of That's Life.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: But I had no idea that that crafty fox would be there! She brought up the Test of Courage event and suggested I give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I wasn't interested, but she said, "The mighty general of Watatsumi Island isn't afraid of anything, is he?"

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: And before I knew it, I found myself caught in her persuasive mind games. *sigh* I immediately regretted it the moment I arrived here. There could be traps everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, this event's sounding more and more dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: My instinct tells me that the forest is chock-full of ambushes. One misstep and it'll be over.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Perhaps that crafty fox is hiding somewhere in the dark, waiting for another opportunity to tease me. Who knows, she might even use a Kamera and send embarrassing photos back to Watatsumi Island...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Her Excellency once said, "When you march into an ambush, escape the enemy vanguard. When escape is impossible, then seek ample reinforcements."

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm, now that you're here, maybe we can turn the tables. Could I ask you two to partner up with me?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Gorou.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Great! This'll be our chance to fight side by side once again!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: With you around, there's nothing to fear! That crafty fox's games are over!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Oh, sure... I completely understand. Perhaps you have a friend you'd like to enter the Test of Courage with?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Anyway, whoever you decide to partner up with, the most important thing is to enjoy the event. Good luck!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There was a familiar scent upon the wind. I knew that I'd see you around here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kazuha!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't expect to see you at the Test of Courage!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And why's that? Do I seem unsuited for this sort of event?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, not at all! It's just that Paimon's never seen you get scared, Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're always so calm and collected. It's like you've never been scared by anything!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You flatter me. I suppose that's only a reflection of my time wandering the wilderness. I've heard many strange stories in my travels.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I can say I've even experienced a few myself. Over time, I must have gotten used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that makes sense! But uh, why do you want to join the Test of Courage?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After hearing the Yashiro Commission promote the rewards for this event, I was guessing that you two would show up.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Since we hadn't seen each other for some time, I figured I might as well come and see you. After all, meeting someone after being apart for so long always lifts the spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so you were waiting for us?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: That's right. So, tell me, how has your journey been lately?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Things have gone pretty well! Uh, by the way, the shrine maiden told us that everyone needs a partner to participate in the Test of Courage event. Have you found a partner yet, Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No, not yet. Do you need me to be your partner?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Kazuha.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Very well, then. I wouldn't mind a walk together.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I haven't participated in many of these events, so I'm curious what new experiences lie ahead.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Take your time. We'll have plenty of chances to talk later, so there's no need to make a choice this very instant.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: We could even go together for a late night snack once the event is over.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Oh, have you decided whether or not to participate with me?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Gorou.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Great! This'll be our chance to fight side by side once again!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: With you around, there's nothing to fear! That crafty fox's games are over!

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Oh, alright... To be honest, I was really looking forward to the chance of teaming up with you.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: With the two of us fighting together, I feel like we could take on any enemy!

dialogues.text: Oh no, you spotted me!
Shh! Please, not a word of this to anyone! Otherwise, they'll dock my pay.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This reminds me of a story that a retainer once told me several years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: There was a wandering samurai who, while crossing the forest at night, noticed that the familiar scenery was beginning to change right in front of him.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The man stopped and realized that it was as if he was in another world. Strange creatures that didn't appear to be human were all staring at him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whaa! That's super scary! Paimon doesn't even dare look at all these trees after hearing that story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Will we really be okay...? If anything weird jumps out at us, teach it a lesson, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Oh, I'll show you how scary this oni can be!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Wait... Are these fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, they suddenly lit up! We'd better keep our distance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get out of here!
The torment~...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Did you hear that voice?
Ah, the torment~... You will suffer with me~!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Could it be... a spirit that's haunting this place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oohhh~ We're not here to bother you, uh no need to torment us! We'll even ask someone at the Grand Narukami Shrine to come and free you... hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, Paimon thought we found it, but it doesn't seem to be here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep searching somewhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have we reached the end? Paimon doesn't see anything here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems we went the wrong way... Let's try a different path!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please... stay a little closer.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Would you like to stop for a rest?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something off about this place...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: This unsettling feeling reminds me of a strange story I heard among the troops.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A strange story? Is it... scary?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: According to the story, there was an army that was marching through a deserted forest when they discovered a stockpile of delicious food.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: The troops were short on provisions, so they came to a halt and began to eat heartily. Before long, they suddenly noticed several pairs of blood-red eyes staring at them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh! Paimon's heard enough! What a scary story... *whimper*

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hehe, just as I predicted! They're coming right our way!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It's time, Ushi! Let's give 'em a scare! Heeheehee.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: A surprise attack! I can't see anything!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: It's an ambush! Everyone, fall back!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: We should be safe here...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wait, what's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's fireworks... Whew, Paimon was scared half to death...
Pain~... The painnn~...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Huh? Who goes there? Identify yourself!
No brain~... Ahh, the painnn...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—No brain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, this is creeping Paimon out. Let's sneak by and stay out of sight...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: There may be ambushes waiting in the forest. Let's stick to the road signs.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Shouldn't we move out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or does Chinju Forest feel a little gloomier than before?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I haven't sensed anything particularly different. How about I tell you a story...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Once, in my wandering travels, I came upon a bridge, and I had been told that an ominous presence awaited those who cross that bridge at night.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It was said that there were a pair of lovebirds who tragically fell into the water below and perished. Their grieving spirits converged around the bridge and were never dispersed.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: So, I picked a night to cross the bridge, and as I was crossing, I heard some voices.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An—And then?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I stopped and listened for some time, and realized it was a couple disguised as ghosts who blackmailed passersby for their belongings. They were arguing over how to split their ill-gotten loot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, after hearing that, Paimon doesn't feel so scared anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You have no idea how long we've been waiting here! Hahaha! Let's go, Ushi!!!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Careful, there's something up above.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *coughing* What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, fireworks? Whew, Paimon was scared half to death...
The horror~... The horrorrr~...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hello? Is someone there?
I will haunt you... and you shall know my horror~!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm also curious about what's over there, but we should continue following the signs for now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, you'll never guess what Paimon just heard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Yashiro Commission is holding a Test of Courage event! They've even prepared rewards for participants who can pass the event's challenges!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But uh, if it's a "Test of Courage," that means it's probably gonna be scary, right? So, if we join, Paimon's gonna let you go first...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You get separated from your partner during the Test of Courage
